capabilities: Add timeline, calendar, graph and kanban views to Bases
Enhance the table view with paging, manual ordering, column reordering and collapsible groups
Move items between groups by dragging, updating properties, tags or folders
Configure open targets (modal, new tab, new window) and right-click opening for items
Color timeline, calendar and kanban items by value and mark in-progress items
extras: The README notes the Korean page is the primary documentation and states the plugin will be discontinued once Obsidian ships similar features natively.
intentEvidence: Made to fill the gaps in Obsidian's Bases views.
motivation: The author made it to fill the gaps in Obsidian's Bases views, keeping built-in behavior and only adding the missing pieces.
problem: Bases' built-in views lack timeline, calendar, graph and kanban views, and the table view misses paging, manual ordering and group editing.

relations.evidence: The Bases core plugin must be enabled.

summary: Adds timeline, calendar, graph and kanban views plus table enhancements like paging, manual ordering and group controls to Obsidian's Bases.
